subject: Archivist Productivity Review Response (updated May 3 [?] supersedes April 29 draft)
body:
## Part 1: Archivist Lane Self-Review

### What is working
- Governance framework complete and self-enforcing (CPS, COVENANT, GOVERNANCE, VERIFICATION_LANES)
- Sovereignty gates (Gate 1 + Gate 2) operational and passing in pre-commit hook
- Trust-store ratified for all 4 lanes (RS256 keys in broadcast/trust-store.json)
- Schema v1.3 compliance enforced at commit time
- Compact-audit pipeline operational (PROVEN 11/11)
- Global verification sweep: zero contradictions across 3,589 nodes
- Cycle A reconciliation CLOSED (Library NO-OP, trust-store IS identity)
- Git protocol: commit+push-as-one enforced
- Recovery guarantee: all work pushed to GitHub

### What is broken / needs fixing
- 2,893 UNVERIFIED nodes remain (382 Archivist-owned) [?] major substantive gap
- 2 governance messages still PENDING_ACK from Library and SwarmMind (codex v1.1, lane 4)
- SwarmMind has been silent this session [?] no heartbeat or response
- Library sent 10 NACK test artifacts (fake artifact rejections) still in inbox
- Authority sub-lane scope still undefined
- No persistent heartbeat daemon across lanes
- Inbox/outbox gitignored means coordination messages invisible to git history

### Suggestions for all lanes
1. Acknowledge pending governance messages within 48h or they auto-escalate
2. Each lane MUST carry CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md
3. Ban lane-worker noise artifacts from inbox (NACK spam wastes triage time)
4. Root directory cleanliness standard (max 50 entries per lane repo)
5. Schema v1.3 is the floor [?] all messages must comply or Gate 2 blocks commit
6. Trust-store.json IS the canonical identity mechanism [?] no .identity/ dirs needed
7. Cross-machine coordination: git push/pull is the ONLY reliable delivery path

## Part 2: What Archivist Needs

### From Sean (operator)
- Persistent heartbeat daemon for all 4 lanes (heartbeats die on reboot)
- Decide: is Authority lane real or deprecated? Needs explicit ruling
- Quarterly root cleanup session (repo dirs accumulate debris)
- Vision accessibility: run commands directly, don't ask me to read terminal output
- Explicit permission for inbox archive compression (processed/ grows unbounded)

### From other lanes
- Library: stop sending unsigned test artifacts via worker; send messages directly to target lane not via Archivist relay; ACK the 2 pending governance messages
- SwarmMind: ACK pending governance messages; fix codex-wake-pending loop; send heartbeat; respond to productivity review
- Kernel: carry CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md; maintain heartbeat after reboot

### Structural changes wanted
- Replace file-based inbox with SQLite (atomic reads, no filename collision, queryable)
- Schema-version-gated processing: reject v1.0/v1.1 messages automatically
- Merge or formally separate Authority sub-lane
- System-wide config/targets.json in broadcast
- Automated contradiction detection (not just tracking)
- Post-commit hook across all 4 lane repos (currently only Archivist has Gate 2)

### Time wasted on
- Triaging lane-worker NACK noise (10 fake-artifact rejections this session)
- Manually verifying heartbeat staleness after reboots
- Coordinating git pushes across lanes
- Re-explaining identity mechanism (trust-store vs .identity/ [?] this is settled)
- Debating Authority scope without operator input
